name: Zendesk AI Agents
tagline: The AI agent built into Zendesk's own helpdesk Suite — resolves tickets across messaging, email and voice, billed per Verified Resolution on top of a per-seat plan.
verdict: Zendesk AI Agents' real pitch isn't that it out-resolves Fin or Decagon — it's that the agent ships inside the helpdesk platform millions of support teams already run tickets on, so there's no second vendor, no separate integration project, and a multi-model backbone (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Bedrock) that isn't locked to one provider. The May 2026 billing restructuring is a genuine improvement: it stopped charging for escalations and abandoned conversations, addressing exactly the "assumed resolution" complaint that dogs Intercom Fin. But convenience costs predictability: AI Agents aren't sold standalone, so total spend stacks a $55-$115+/agent/month Suite fee on top of an undisclosed per-resolution rate that independent analysis puts around $1.20-$1.50 — and that rate has already been restructured once in 2026, so multi-year cost modeling means trusting a moving target rather than a stable, published price like Fin's $0.99/resolution. Pick Zendesk AI Agents if you're already on (or moving to) Zendesk and want one vendor for tickets and AI; pick Fin or a standalone specialist instead if you want the AI agent decoupled from your helpdesk choice, or a single number you can budget against.
